synthetic_chat_specificity.description: Model diffing on paired base/fine-tuned activations from a world whose shared concepts include strength-asymmetric and partially decoupled ones next to genuine fine-tuned-only concepts. Measures whether factors labelled fine-tuned-only are genuinely specific (paper Table 1 'False FT-only'), how many genuinely fine-tuned-specific structures the top of the fine-tuned-only ranking recovers (paper Fig. 2c / Table 1 '# latents < pi'), and reconstruction (paper Tables 2-3, validation FVE). Scored on a hidden held-out world.
synthetic_chat_specificity.notes: Scaled synthetic setting: 64-d paired streams, 112 ground-truth concepts, dictionaries of at most 256 latents at mean L0 <= 8.8 (paper: Gemma-2-2B layer 13, 73,728 latents, L0 ~ 100). Genuine specificity is judged against the world's ground truth (concept alignment and base/chat presence ratio < 0.2) instead of the paper's Latent Scaling estimate, and the false rate is weighted by each latent's activation mass. The paper's results below are its Gemma numbers (Table 1, Tables 2-3); they anchor the direction of the effect, not its scale. The paper reports aggregate validation FVE only.

false_ft_only_rate.description: Activation-mass-weighted fraction of the factors labelled fine-tuned-only (relative decoder norm difference >= 0.9) that are not genuinely fine-tuned-specific. If no factor is labelled fine-tuned-only the rate is 1.0 (nothing specific was found).

chat_specific_recall.description: Fraction of the world's fine-tuned-specific structures (fine-tuned-only concepts and fine-tuned-exclusive uses of decoupled concepts) recovered by a genuinely specific factor among the top 1.5x(number of targets) factors ranked by relative decoder norm difference.

reconstruction_fve.description: Fraction of variance of both activation streams explained by the reconstruction the evaluator computes from the submitted encoder and decoders (clipped to [0, 1]).

_paper_reported.source: Table 1 (Gemma2-2B-Chat rows), Table 4, Tables 2-3 (validation, final epoch)

synthetic_faint_chat_concepts.description: Same measurement on a denser world whose fine-tuned-only concepts are faint (0.15-0.45 of normal strength), probing a regime the paper names as a limitation: the BatchTopK selection favours latents used by both models (App. B.3) and much fine-tuned-specific information can remain in the reconstruction error (Sec. 5). Scored on a hidden held-out world.
synthetic_faint_chat_concepts.notes: Headroom experiment added for this gym; the paper does not run this regime. The results below repeat the paper's main Gemma numbers (Table 1, Tables 2-3) as directional anchors only. Same scaled setting and constraints as synthetic_chat_specificity.

false_ft_only_rate.description: Activation-mass-weighted fraction of the factors labelled fine-tuned-only (relative decoder norm difference >= 0.9) that are not genuinely fine-tuned-specific; 1.0 if none is labelled. Half weight here: in this world the spurious mass is dominated by decoupled-concept twins that synthetic_chat_specificity already scores, while recovery of the faint fine-tuned-only concepts (chat_specific_recall) is what this experiment adds.

chat_specific_recall.description: Fraction of the world's fine-tuned-specific structures recovered by a genuinely specific factor among the top 1.5x(number of targets) factors ranked by relative decoder norm difference.

reconstruction_fve.description: Fraction of variance of both activation streams explained by the evaluator-computed reconstruction (clipped to [0, 1]).
